implementation.identity: Persistent instance UUID distinct from reusable SessionID; committed birth immutable, aborted construction never publishes.
implementation.provenance: create/fork/herb/resume and explicit Native flow_create retryOf UUID; last logical parent and failed termination validated without automatic retry policy.
implementation.persistence: Run envelope v2 persists true timestamps and Assignment instance UUIDs; no v1 compatibility. Journal original and uncertain bytes retained, full-state recovery in new durable segment.
implementation.connection: Six loopback HTTP routes, exact Host/Origin, short-lived Bearer, fetch SSE, independent cursors and subscription generations.
implementation.operations: operationId plus targetEpoch; mutually exclusive agentId or scope:run for starting Runs without a root. Accepted and terminal state are separate.
implementation.usage: Actual rc.2 assistant-stream/durable event sequence correlation; cumulative call replacement, auxiliary call attribution and cleanup/automatic refusal facts.
implementation.client: Constructive complete DTO decoding with reference checks, additive/unknown event handling, reconnect and failure recovery.

implementationExtensions.stopRunTarget: scope:run is the minimum explicit whole-Run management target for starting Runs without a root; it never invents an instance ID.
implementationExtensions.retryIntent: Optional retryOf in the existing Native flow_create tool is explicit parent intent, not a new public Core method or retry strategy. Tool results expose instanceId so the model can obtain the source identity.
implementationExtensions.usageIdentity: Optional internal callId/kind associates actual Native calls; generic hosts must provide stable call IDs to deduplicate reports represented by different objects.
implementationExtensions.priceUnits: Per million tokens; explicit actual model and currency; missing price/total stays unavailable.
